heading: Questions owners actually ask
intro: The honest answers, including the ones that lose us business.

items.question: Do I have to switch POS systems?
items.answer: No. We work with Toast, Square, and Clover as they are. If you're on something rarer, we'll tell you in the first call whether we can reconcile it — before you've paid anything.

items.question: What do you need from me each week?
items.answer: About ten minutes: forwarding vendor invoices as they arrive and answering the occasional question about an unfamiliar charge. Everything else pulls from your POS and bank feeds automatically.

items.question: Can you take over mid-year from my current bookkeeper?
items.answer: Yes, and it's common. We do a catch-up close on the current year first — typically two to three weeks — so the weekly rhythm starts from clean numbers, not inherited ones.

items.question: Do you do my taxes too?
items.answer: No. We hand your CPA a clean, reconciled year — which usually makes their bill smaller — but filing stays with them. If you don't have a CPA, we'll introduce you to two we trust with restaurants.

items.question: What happens on the monthly call?
items.answer: Thirty minutes on three numbers: plate cost, labor mix, and waste, compared to your own last quarter. You leave with one specific change to make and a way to see whether it worked by the next call.

items.question: What if my books are a mess right now?
items.answer: That's the normal starting point, not a problem. The catch-up close is priced separately and quoted up front after we look at the actual state of your ledger — no hourly meter running while we dig.
